import os

config = AppConfig.model_validate({'analysis': {'enable_angr': False, 'enable_ghidra': False, 'enable_frida': False, 'enable_gef': False, 'gef_timeout': 60, 'gef_max_instructions': 10000, 'require_elf': False}, 'extract': {'enable': False, 'extract_elf': False, 'timeout_s': 60, 'max_files': 200, 'max_bytes': 67108864, 'max_depth': 2}, 'performance': {'parallel_functions': 4}, 'ghidra': {'use_bridge': False, 'max_decompile_functions': 20, 'max_types': 100, 'max_strings': 200}})

    binary,
    config=config,
    options=AnalysisOptions(

        extract=False,

assert report.payload['provenance']['input']['sha256'] == expected_sha256
